verification.method: Recovered original private records and compared their bytes with preexisting historical manifests. Recomputed aggregate comparison metrics from the hash-matched result file. No new comparison or remote service call was performed.

comparison.conclusion: No demonstrated decision improvement; memory remains off by default.

retained_corrections: The original comparison exposed readable case labels and remains functional evidence only.
The failed opaque-v2 startup and its frozen inputs are retained. The original report records all 48 scheduled failures before model/service calls.
The corrected run reused the same eight cases with a different lesson snapshot; the runs must not be pooled.
limits: These reports predate the repair batches and do not validate the current alpha runtime or current remote service availability.
Eight repeated synthetic cases do not establish broad accuracy, statistical significance, decision improvement or a general latency/cost benchmark.
Raw provider request bytes and complete retrieved policy text were not originally persisted; they cannot be recovered.
Manifest matching demonstrates consistency with the retained historical manifests; it is not independent cryptographic authentication of those manifests.
Raw records, provider identifiers, private lesson bodies/identifiers, legacy decision exports, videos and screenshots remain private and are not included in this summary.
